steps.label: debates on the adoption
steps.quote: During the debates on the adoption of the Constitution, its opponents repeatedly charged that

steps.label: tyranny by the central government
steps.quote: the Constitution as drafted would open the way to tyranny by the central government.

steps.label: bill of rights
steps.quote: They demanded a "bill of rights" that would spell out the immunities of individual citizens.

steps.label: state conventions
steps.quote: Several state conventions in their formal ratification of the Constitution asked for such amendments

steps.label: First Congress
steps.quote: the First Congress of the United States therefore proposed to the state legislatures 12 amendments to the Constitution
